exposure: Induction of labor with low dose PGE2
labor induction with low-dose vaginal prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) in grandmultiparous women with a previous cesarean delivery
Grandmultiparous women without a previous cesarean delivery
Grandmultiparous women with a previous cesarean delivery
cohort: 219 grandmultiparous women with a previous cesarean delivery and 1376 grandmultiparous women without a previous cesarean section
finding: Low dose PGE2 for induction of labor in grandmultiparous women with a previous cesarean section was associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery and operative vaginal delivery but no significant differences in uterine rupture, postpartum hemorrhage, or low 5-minute Apgar score compared to grandmultiparous women without a prior cesarean section.
mod_finding: Patients in the study group (grandmultiparous women with a previous cesarean delivery) had a significantly higher rate of cesarean delivery (6.84%, versus 3.4%, respectively, p < 0.001) as well as operative vaginal delivery (4.56% versus 2% respectively, p < 0.05) compared to the control group.
